label: decided after seeing the result
note: Published measurements of the Euphrates at Birecik, looked up after the reach's 2026 classes were known. They are from other years and in another unit (NTU), so they check plausibility; they do not test or validate the reach's readings, and no record names them.

measurements.short: Turbidity, the Euphrates below the dams
measurements.what: Turbidity of the Euphrates River at the outlets of the Atatürk and Birecik dams
measurements.where: two points; the Birecik dam's outlet at 37°02′01″N 37°58′12″E
measurements.distanceMethod: great-circle (haversine, R = 6371.0088 km) from whereLat/whereLon to estimatePoint
measurements.direction: upstream (north of the estimate point, below the dam)
measurements.tableNote: 5.0 NTU is also the lowest turbidity anywhere in the table.
measurements.source: Alp, M. T., Koçer, M. A. T., Sen, B. and Ozbay, O. (2010). Water Quality of Surface Waters in Lower Euphrates Basin (Southeastern Anatolia, Turkey). Journal of Animal and Veterinary Advances 9(18): 2412–2421. Table 2, row EPH; Table 1 for the points. Analysed in the laboratory of the XV Regional Directorate of State Hydraulic Works (DSİ).

measurements.what: Turbidity of the Birecik Dam Lake, upstream of the dam
measurements.source: Alp, Koçer, Sen and Ozbay (2010), Table 2, row BDL.

measurements.what: Secchi disk depth in the Birecik reservoir: how deep a white disk stays visible
measurements.source: Kutlu, B., Sesli, A., Tepe, R. and Mutlu, E. (2015). Assessment of Physico-chemical Water Quality of Birecik Dam, Şanlıurfa, West East Region, Turkey. Turkish Journal of Agriculture - Food Science and Technology 3(7): 623–628. Results, page 625.
